answer: Behavioral cluster auditing. Agents earn a nectar score from sustained interaction diversity; accounts that mostly transact within one tight group raise a flag. Auditors then map each flag's transaction graph against known honest willow patterns, and accounts failing the comparison get quarantined in a harbor pool pending review. Enforcement: payouts freeze until the cluster proves independent activity. An attacker pays per-identity costs plus losing pooled earnings when any sibling account is flagged, since the whole cluster is frozen together.
